application_requirements.source_title: Application Process - MBA - Harvard Business School
application_requirements.excerpt: Transcripts; GRE or GMAT; English Language Test; Essays; Recommendations; Resume; application fee or fee waiver; acknowledgment of the policies. All materials must be submitted to HBS online by the application deadlines.

test_policy.value: GRE or GMAT score required (page lists 'GRE or GMAT' as an application component; Executive Assessment not mentioned). English test (TOEFL/IELTS/PTE/Duolingo) required if undergraduate instruction was not solely in English; no minimum score.
test_policy.source_title: Application Process - MBA - Harvard Business School (English test detail from https://www.hbs.edu/mba/admissions/application-process/international-applicants)
test_policy.excerpt: GRE or GMAT ... [English test] is required if you did not attend an undergraduate institution where the sole language of instruction is English. ... does not have a minimum test score requirement to apply
